evals.prompt: Download the source code of this project's dependencies for AI reference.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads the source-fetcher skill, scans package manifests recursively (skipping node_modules/target/dist/build), resolves each dependency, and downloads sources into ./references/src/<package>/.
assertions: node_modules and build output directories excluded from scan

evals.prompt: Run fetch-sources with --cleanup to remove the downloaded sources.
evals.expected_output: Agent invokes the skill's cleanup mode: deletes downloaded source directories under ./references/src/, preserves sources.json (the cache/override manifest) for future runs.
assertions: Cleanup mode removes downloaded source trees
Idempotent: second cleanup run reports nothing to remove

evals.prompt: Fetch dependency sources, but pin lodash to our vendored fork at github.com/us/lodash.
evals.expected_output: Agent consults sources.json manual overrides first; user-specified or pre-existing override entries take precedence over auto-detected registry resolution for that package.
assertions: Manual override entry honored over default resolution
